# TruthBeam

> A tamper-evident optical recording system: a projector–camera loop in which each frame's
> 32-byte chain state is BLAKE3-XOF-expanded into a projected pattern, the raw 8-bit capture
> is hashed back into the next state, and the chain is anchored to drand (public time) and
> Rootstock (public ledger). A 39.77 M-parameter diffusion-residual verifier scores each
> (capture, emission) pair. Patent pending; all rights reserved — no licence is granted.

Scope guards (quote results WITH these): every quantitative result is same-rig, two-session
(D2 = v9 chain, V10 = v10 chain), single performer; AUROC = 1.000 figures are finite-sample
held-out estimates (n=198 / n=200); the only trained attacker is F-A v1; F-A v2 is design-only,
so no adaptive-attacker robustness is claimed.

## Verify (no GPU)

- [code/recording/verify/verify_generator_hash.py](code/recording/verify/verify_generator_hash.py): code → hash (generator source digest committed in S_0)
- [code/recording/verify/verify_v9.py](code/recording/verify/verify_v9.py): D2 chain walk (`--session-dir <dir>`; `--logs-only` verifies the chain math from ~4 MB of metadata)
- [code/recording/verify/verify_v10.py](code/recording/verify/verify_v10.py): V10 chain walk (v10 transition incl. ai_payload_root)
- [code/recording/verify/README_BUNDLE.md](code/recording/verify/README_BUNDLE.md) / [README_BUNDLE_v10.md](code/recording/verify/README_BUNDLE_v10.md): session-bundle reader's guides
- [code/recording/verify/CLAIMS.md](code/recording/verify/CLAIMS.md) / [CLAIMS_v10.md](code/recording/verify/CLAIMS_v10.md): tiered claims manifests (DEMONSTRATED / ASSERTED / FUTURE)

## Results (primary artifacts)

- [results/eval/](results/eval/): held-out eval summaries — headline AUROCs, shuffled control, F-A v1 checkpoints, cross-session report
- [results/csv/visual_metrics_wide.csv](results/csv/visual_metrics_wide.csv): frame-level metric table, 9,735 rows × 33 cols
- [results/eval/exp6_correct_e_rank/](results/eval/exp6_correct_e_rank/): EXP-6 per-frame ranking raw data (n=120 × 51 candidates)
- [results/redteam_segmentation_evals/](results/redteam_segmentation_evals/): segmentation ablation, XOF bit-flip tables, excess-red, low-frequency recovery
